reviews.use_summary: Builds the taxonomy tree with build_dend using type-average expression of 1,871 marker genes; draws 15-neighbor constellation relationships with plot_constellation; integrates WB10x, WB MERFISH and SPN nuclei using i_harmonize.
uncertainties: Package edition and complete function arguments are unreported. Do not borrow P059 version 0.0.5.
Code availability names scrattch.mapping separately; do not assign all described mapping or centroid operations to that package.
The printed BIGCAT availability URL contains a space in Allen Institute; preserve it as a source-link discrepancy.

reviews.implementation_scope_note: Project availability: original build_dend and plot_constellation plus i_harmonize through explicitly selected source profiles. The selected 2023 source retains its ordinary-matrix harmonization indexing error; a separately selected unchanged 2022/R4.1 profile supports tested three-dataset integration with explicit caller sets. The optional at-least-five-SPN selection follows integration at a caller-chosen hierarchy level. It does not reproduce reciprocal correspondence mapping or the separate fewer-than-three-mapped-cells exclusion. P058 edition, author commit and unreported caller arguments remain unknown; synthetic inputs are project choices. Original objects, conditions, RNG and file-backed assets are retained; cross-process live object identity and paper reproduction are not claimed. Missing/forbidden prerequisites SKIP3 skip dependent analysis; FAIL2 admits no complete result.

reviews.use_summary: Clusters 10xv2 and 10xv3 separately with iter_clust_big and integrates them iteratively; uses chunked Parquet expression and cluster-level differential-expression summaries. Also detects doublet/noise clusters, selects a MERFISH marker panel, draws constellation plots, performs cell-type centroid mapping/cross-validation and partitioned cross-modality imputation.
uncertainties: These roles require original BIGCAT semantics; generic KNN, clustering, marker selection or imputation is not equivalent.
Complete caller inputs/options, manual borderline-cluster review and paper data are not supplied by the synthetic DoubletFinder controls.

reviews.implementation_scope_note: Project availability: unchanged original iter_clust_big, find_doublet_by_marker, select_N_markers, plot_constellation, map_cells_knn_big and impute_cross_big; a separate native Java helper covers dense marker-doublet detection. Synthetic controls exercise the reported v2/v3 DE settings, 50000-cell/500-gene source bins, fivefold mapping with 8460/534/20x534 panels and all training cells per centroid, and declared coarse/fine FBM imputation partitions. Gene lists, folds, data and unreported caller options are project choices. Explicit source profiles are not recovered author commits. Original vector/default-variable/sparse-score/singleton-bin errors remain failures. Complete values, source distances, conditions, RNG and assets are retained. Live R class/environment/pointer identity, manual biological review, whole-package validity and paper reproduction are not claimed. Missing/forbidden prerequisites SKIP3 skip dependent analysis; FAIL2 admits no complete result.
